versions.content: function GeneratePrivateKey [SWS_CRYPT_20722] Upstream: RS_CRYPTO_02003 , RS_CRYPTO_02101 , RS_CRYPTO_02102 , RS_ CRYPTO_02107, RS_CRYPTO_02108 , RS_CRYPTO_02111 , RS_CRYPTO_02115 virtual ara::core::Result < PrivateKey :: Sptr > GeneratePrivateKey (Alg Id algId, AllowedUsageFlags privateKeyAllowedUsage) noexcept=0; Generate a new public/private key pair and return the private key. The public key can be retrieved via the function PrivateKey::GetPublicKey() The allowed usage flags of the Public Key are set based on the allowed usage of the PrivateKey: • kAllowDataDecryption --> kAllowDataEncryption • kAllowSigGeneration --> kAllowSigVerification • kAllowKeyAgreement --> kAllowKeyAgreement • kAllowKeyUnwrapping --> kAllowKeyWrapping Additionally, the allowed usage: • kAllowPlaintextExport • kAllowPersist are set for the public key.
